Messages.Author: Millicent
Messages.Body:
Vampire A bleed and vampire B blocks succesfully, vampire B plays Deep Ecology with pro to untap and now combat begins.

Is this reaction possible to play in this situation ?

Deep Ecology
//
Requires an Anarch.
Only usable during an action directed at you (or a card you control). +2 intercept.
Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire burns 1 blood to unlock.

Thanks in advance !

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Millicent wrote:
> Vampire A bleed and vampire B blocks succesfully, vampire A plays Deep Ecology with pro to untap and now combat begins.
>
> Is this reaction possible to play in this situation ?
>
> Deep Ecology
> //
> Requires an Anarch.
> Only usable during an action directed at you (or a card you control). +2 intercept.
> Reduce a bleed against you by 2.
> Only usable by a locked vampire. This vampire burns 1 blood to unlock.
>
> Thanks in advance !
>
Deep Ecology must be played before resolution. Locking and entering combat is part of the resolution, so it's not possible to play it after locking but before combat.

Prince of Paris, France
